Oncologist, general surgeon, surgeon

Main areas of specialisation:

  • General surgery
  • Surgical oncology
  • Breast cancer
  • Soft tissue sarcoma
  • Melanoma and other skin cancers

Summary:

Dr Dov Zippel is a well-known Israeli oncologist and a leading specialist in the surgical treatment of cancer. He is a senior physician in the surgical oncology department and has more than 20 years of clinical experience.

Dr Zippel's particular professional interest lies in the diagnosis and treatment of breast tumours and skin cancer. His many years as a surgeon allow him to perform operations of any complexity to remove tumours in any location. In his practice he uses only the most innovative minimally invasive methods, which preserve as much healthy tissue as possible and leave almost no trace. Each year he helps a great many patients return to a normal life and put a serious illness behind them.

Having graduated with distinction from the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University, Dr Zippel completed a fellowship in the general surgery department of the Sheba medical centre in Israel. He then specialised in surgical oncology at the University of Calgary in Canada.

The doctor is actively engaged in research. He is the author of many papers on various forms of malignant tumour, all published in the best professional medical journals. Alongside his clinical practice and research, Dov Zippel runs practical classes at Tel Aviv University.

Education:

  • Sackler Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Fellowship in the general surgery department, Sheba Medical Centre, Ramat Gan, Israel
  • Specialisation in surgical oncology, University of Calgary, Canada

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Society of Surgical Oncology
  • Society of Surgical Oncology (SSO)
  • American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO)

Haematologist
Paediatric haematologist

Main areas of specialisation

  1. Treatment of sarcomas of bone and soft tissue
  2. Treatment of thalassaemia
  3. Treatment of spherocytosis
  4. Treatment of leukocytosis
  5. Treatment of thrombocytopenia and other platelet disorders
  6. Treatment of clotting disorders
  7. Treatment of anaemia

Summary

Dr Dror Levin is a leading Israeli paediatric haematologist and haemato-oncologist with more than 20 years of clinical experience. He is a specialist of international standing in the treatment of sarcomas of bone and soft tissue (Ewing's sarcoma, osteosarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma and others), including by bone marrow transplantation. His professional interests also cover haematology and haemato-oncology: anaemia, thrombocytopenia, thrombocytosis, neutropenia and clotting disorders (haemophilia, excessive clotting).

Dr Levin gives consultations on blood disorders, including clotting problems in very young children, both newborn and premature. Patients seek his authoritative opinion on blood clotting before surgery, before dental procedures and when using hormonal contraception.

Dr Levin is known for his achievements in diagnosing and treating a wide range of complex and chronic blood disorders in newborns, children and adolescents. In his daily practice he applies the most modern methods of treatment. He has received an award from the President of Israel for his achievements and his contribution to modern medicine.

A true professional and an excellent doctor, he knows how to reassure and support a sick child and their family. The greatest happiness, in Dr Levin's words, is to see the happy faces of patients who have recovered.

Additional specialisation

  • Congenital and acquired disorders of the bone marrow
  • Treatment of conditions of the lymph nodes
  • Bone marrow transplantation

Education

  • Faculty of Medicine, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Israel
  • Fellowship in paediatrics at the Kaplan hospital, Rehovot, Israel
  • Fellowship in paediatric haemato-oncology at the Schneider children's hospital, Petah Tikva, Israel
  • Fellowship in the treatment of bone and soft tissue sarcomas in children at the leading Italian paediatric centre Rizzoli Bologna Ortopedia Pediatrica

Languages

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations

  • Israel Society of Haematology
  • Israel Society of Paediatric Haematology and Oncology (ISPHO)
  • Israel Society of Clinical Paediatrics
  • Israel society for the treatment of thrombosis and clotting disorders
  • European Musculo-Skeletal Oncology Society (EMSOS)

Endocrinologist

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Diabetes
  • Diseases of the thyroid gland
  • Diseases of the pituitary gland
  • Hormonal disorders
  • Disorders of lipid metabolism
  • Treatment of osteoporosis
  • Excess hair growth in women (hirsutism)
  • Thyroid cancer
  • Cancer of the adrenal glands

Summary:
Dr Elena Izhakov is an endocrinologist and a well-known, much sought-after Israeli specialist in the study and treatment of various disorders of the endocrine system: diabetes, diseases of the thyroid and pituitary glands, osteoporosis, hormonal disorders, excess hair growth in women (hirsutism), disorders of lipid metabolism, obesity and others. Dr Izhakov also specialises in the treatment of cancer of the thyroid and adrenal glands.

Her particular professional interest is the treatment of hormonal disorders that lead to infertility.

She is a senior physician in the endocrinology department of a medical centre, with more than 30 years of clinical experience. She provides consultation and treatment for adults and for children of all ages.

In her daily practice she applies all the most advanced modern methods of diagnosing and treating thyroid disease, and uses the newest developments in international pharmacology. Dr Izhakov's success rate is high: where patients come to her in good time and effective treatment is prescribed, their chances of recovery approach 95 to 98 per cent.

Dr Elena Izhakov is a doctor of rich experience and great ability. She constantly develops her skills and applies the newest medical advances in endocrinology in practice. She speaks three languages fluently, which makes her one of the most sought-after doctors in her field.

Education:

  • Tashkent Medical University, Uzbekistan
  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Fellowship in internal medicine at the Ichilov hospital, Tel Aviv, Israel
  • Fellowship in endocrinology at the Ichilov hospital, Tel Aviv, Israel

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • Russian

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Society of Internal Medicine
  • Israel Endocrine Society
  • European Society of Endocrinology
  • American Association of Clinical Endocrinologists

Professor Eli Ashkenazi is an outstanding Israeli neurosurgeon and head of the spinal surgery department at the Hadassah clinic. He specialises in the surgical treatment of congenital and acquired disorders of the spinal cord and spine, the correction of scoliosis and the treatment of spinal tumours.

Among other things, Dr Ashkenazi specialises in reconstructing the structures of the spine using innovative TOPS implants, a promising system capable of replacing the anatomical structures removed during decompression of the vertebrae.

His former patients in Russia, Ukraine, the United States and Europe speak highly of his skill and his individual attention. Another attraction for patients from abroad is the more affordable cost of operations compared with leading neurosurgeons in Western Europe and the United States.

Education and clinical experience:

  • Medical degree, faculty of medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem.
  • Fellowship in neurosurgery at the Hadassah university medical centre, Jerusalem.
  • Training at clinics abroad, including the Montefiore medical centre in New York.

Research work:

  • Teaches students at the Hebrew University.
  • More than 50 published papers in Israel and Europe on surgery and on new instruments and techniques in neurosurgery.

Membership of professional organisations:

  • Israel Medical Association.
  • Israel Neurosurgical Society.
  • European Association of Neurosurgical Societies.
  • Israel Spine Surgery Association.
  • North American Spine Society.

Languages

  • English
  • Hebrew
  • Russian

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Otolaryngology
  • Head and neck surgery

Summary:

Dr Eran Emanuel Alon is a leading Israeli specialist in otolaryngology and head and neck surgery. He provides expert care to adults and children alike. His experience and professionalism are recognised both in Israel and beyond.

Dr Alon is not only a highly qualified clinician but also an expert much in demand among colleagues, who often turn to him for advice in complex and contested cases. He takes part regularly in medical case conferences, helping to reach the right treatment decisions for patients with a range of conditions.

Dr Alon is also actively engaged in research. His work has been recognised in the professional community and has received a number of prestigious prizes and grants. In recent years he has given particular attention to developing head and neck surgery in developing countries.

Alongside his clinical and research work, Dr Alon teaches at leading universities in Israel and the United States. His research has been published more than 80 times in international medical journals. He also speaks regularly at international conferences and symposia, sharing his research and his practical experience.

Education:

  • Faculty of Medicine, Technion, Haifa, Israel
  • Faculty of Medicine, Hebrew University, Jerusalem, Israel
  • Fellowship in the department of head and neck surgery and microvascular reconstruction at Beth Israel Medical Center, New York, USA
  • Fellowship in the department of otolaryngology and head and neck surgery at the Mayo Clinic, Minnesota, USA

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Association of Otolaryngology
  • Israel Society for Head and Neck Surgery and Oncology
  • American Medical Association
  • American Academy of Otolaryngology

Haematologist, haemato-oncologist

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Haematology: anaemias, thalassaemias
  • Oncology: lymphomas, leukaemias, myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS), multiple myeloma
  • Bone marrow transplantation of all kinds: allogeneic, autologous, haploidentical
  • Cellular immunotherapy: preventing the recurrence of cancer after bone marrow transplantation, and cancer prevention
  • Haemofiltration: myasthenia gravis, inherited chronic conditions
  • Blood clotting: thrombosis, bleeding

Summary:

Dr Fredi Aviv is a leading haemato-oncologist in Israel, a highly qualified doctor of international standing with almost 30 years of experience. He specialises in the diagnosis and treatment of a wide range of blood disorders and is an international expert in transplantation. He is rightly considered one of the best specialists performing transplants of bone marrow and blood cells.

Fredi Aviv received an excellent education and combines deep knowledge with clinical practice to great effect. He is known for his calm manner, his optimism and his positive outlook.

Alongside his main clinical work, Fredi Aviv is actively engaged in research. He takes part in international research projects on stem cell transplantation. Dr Aviv is the author of many publications in specialist medical journals and presents papers at national and international forums and conferences.

Dr Fredi Aviv consults at public and private clinics, teaches haematology at Tel Aviv University and runs a course at the Israeli Ministry of Health. He lectures on haematology, haemato-oncology and transplantation to colleagues from Israel, Austria and England.

Education:

  • Azerbaijan Medical University, Doctor of Medicine (MD)
  • Clinical residency and internship in internal medicine, haematology and haemato-oncology at Tel Aviv University, Israel

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • Russian

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association (IMA)
  • Israel Society of Internal Medicine (ISID)
  • Israel Haematology Association (IHA)
  • American Society of Hematology
  • European Hematology Association (EHA)
